tableLines.line: The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Theo speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.

scaleLines.line: 🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (Cliffhanger, Night Court, Flashbulb Moth, The Mountain Lord, Sweeps Week) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

🚨 Cliffhanger, Night Court, Flashbulb Moth, The Mountain Lord, Sweeps Week is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.
📓 Codex: Cliffhanger, Night Court, Flashbulb Moth, The Mountain Lord, Sweeps Week at the door, day 8.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Night Court is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

🔥 The fire settles. Sophia has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Night Court — I put it down today." "No sound. That is the warning. The moon-shadow on the ground is growing — and there is no sound at all. Owls don't make sound when they hunt." "It missed — and it is already turning. The second dive re-aims at where you moved." ⚔️ Sophia killed the Night Court with their party — 6 rounds, 37 taken. Word travels fast. The village cheers.

On the carcass nearby, Cliffhanger (carcass), Night Court (carcass), Flashbulb Moth (carcass), The Mountain Lord (carcass), Sweeps Week (carcass) went bad — maggots, smell, the whole sad story. Leaving it had a cost.

🧳 Word of Haven’s the televised games, new bindings is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: Emberhold and Stonebridge have bound together — Emberhold primary. Other fires are climbing, too.
